Howland Township Zoning Department Zoning Fact Sheet # 5 – Temporary Signs What is a temporary sign? A temporary sign is designed, constructed, or installed in a manner that is not suitable for permanent display. Examples of temporary signage include, but not limited to, staked signs, sidewalk signs, banners, and portable framed signs. Is a zoning permit required for temporary signs? Yes, a zoning permit is required for all temporary signs in all zoning districts whether it is attached to the building or free standing. Zoning permits are issued by Howland Township. One exception has been made to allow one free-standing sidewalk sign per business space without a zoning permit. The size of the sidewalk sign shall not exceed six (6) square feet per side and a height of four (4) feet and it must not be illuminated. The sign must be located within ten (10) feet of the building. What are the t
